<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>AgentCircuits.Core</id>
    <version>0.7.135-routed-input-auth.1</version>
    <authors>Agent Circuits</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Agent-Circuits/agentcircuits</projectUrl>
    <description>A high-performance C# SDK for building AI agent systems. Simple by default, powerful when needed. Build everything from one-shot AI queries to complex multi-agent orchestrations—all in idiomatic C# with minimal overhead.</description>
    <releaseNotes>Core agent framework with streaming, multimodal input, auto-compaction, token monitoring, multi-agent orchestration, MCP integration, and web management portal.</releaseNotes>
    <tags>ai agents llm anthropic openai gemini ollama claude gpt mcp model-context-protocol agentic multi-agent tools streaming</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Agent-Circuits/agentcircuits.git" commit="0cbd51da2b755fd1ff5b83467afa25a685006a36" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Abstractions" version="10.0.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" version="10.0.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="ModelContextProtocol" version="1.1.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="PdfPig" version="0.1.13" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="ReverseMarkdown" version="5.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="YamlDotNet" version="16.3.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions" version="10.0.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Options" version="10.0.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
